definition: A gene encoding a DExH-box RNA helicase that interacts with BRCA1 to regulate transcription, R-loop resolution, and homologous recombination. Heterozygous pathogenic variants in DHX9 impair neurodevelopment and neuronal homeostasis, leading to neurodevelopmental disorders (such as autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder) and axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease.

source.title: Monoallelic variation in DHX9, the gene encoding the DExH-box helicase DHX9, underlies neurodevelopment disorders and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease
source.quote: DHX9 encodes a BRCA1-interacting nuclear helicase regulating transcription, R-loops, and homologous recombination and exhibits the highest mutational constraint of all DDX/DHX paralogs but remains unassociated with disease traits in OMIM.
